profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Manheim
profile.summary:
RECRUITERS: I am not interested in expanding my network for a new employment opportunity(ies). If you would like to be added to my address book, linked in, or various other networks with the interest in knowing what I am "engaged in currently" or "if you are looking at something new", you will be ignored. However, if you would like to added to my network in the event that I contact you if that changes, please make that known. Also, if you call saying you "found my number," I will not return your call. 

------------

I enjoy the challenge of taking an idea and making it come to life through design and development. I've worked on several web sites for personal projects and for contract work. I enjoyed developing flash games and environments while employed at ISO Interactive. I have my own start up company, Skyler Media where I work on custom site builds and consulting. 

At The Jones Group, I had the opportunity to work on some very major client accounts. While there, I was able to participate in client meetings and offer solutions to their goals and concerns regarding their site. While at Yahoo, I was a core YUI team developer; having used the YUI framework for quite some time, it was pretty nice to be part of the core team. 

I am currently working at Manheim where I focus on the front-end, tools, CSS and JS frameworks and overall end-to-end user experience and guidance. I have strategized and deployed several cross-functional projects that have benefited the developers and enterprise.

My goal is to make a difference in the world by developing sites and tools that enhance the user's life. My ambition is to empower people who empower people. 

Specialties: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Strategic planning, Problem solving, Critical thinking, solution strategist

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: While at Manheim I have driven much of the design system development as share resource development and practice establishments. My dedication to doing a job well has put me in a position where I have been promoted quickly by always addressing the problems that are known as well as problems that will soon arise.

positions.title: Owner / Founder
positions.description: Skyler Media prides itself in custom web application development. From small XHTML / PHP forms, to a fully complex CMS with Flash and AJAX, Skyler Media has the knowledge and experience to develop to your needs in an accurate and timely manner.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Core developer on the YUI Team. Helped maintain and create new modules for the YUI 3 framework. Assisted other teams with development as well as creating custom modules specifically for those teams.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Doing my best to help guide some of our future web developers.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description: Developing internal and external facing applications and site pages. Helping make the awesome even more awesomer.

positions.title: Interactive Director
positions.description: Site design to XHTML/CSS, custom CMS development, and custom application architectural design and development.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed client websites and revamped the internal CMS that helped manage the online Flash MMO games and environments. Also developed an avatar builder and testing environment to assist with in-game processes.

positions.title: Creative Director
positions.description: Managed the web development team. Put in place several processes to speed up development and manage customer expectations. Developed an internal CMS that gave our customers a unique and safe method of maintaining their web site.

positions.title: Geek Squad CIA
positions.description: Recommended, sold, built, and repaired computers on a daily basis.

positions.title: General Contractor
positions.description: Work for my father repairing homes and building new additions to existing homes.
